title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1987-06-28
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth  adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a  Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to  24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR  standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's  MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
source: (Front Row Lawn DFC) 2 Nakamichi CM100s/CP4>Nakamichi550>Sony TCD5M  (Oade erase head removal modifications) w/Dolby B on Maxell MX90  cassettes.

ai_review.summary: A clean, correctly‑paced source captures a wildly enthusiastic show remembered for its pre‑show Bob Marley music and post‑show Sinatra vibe.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for being noticeably cleaner and at the proper speed compared with other sources, suggesting a solid technical capture. Fans rave about the concert’s energy – from “devils in the sky” moments to the memorable pre‑show reggae set and Sinatra finish – making it a beloved performance despite the unknown exact date. Overall the audio quality is good and the show itself is highly regarded.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show 5 stars for its excitement, while another gives a modest 3‑star rating focused on recording quality; weighted together this yields a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaner than other sources and correctly paced; no major flaws mentioned, but source type not identified.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic performance with notable pre‑show Bob Marley music and post‑show Sinatra, creating a memorable atmosphere despite lack of specific song detail.
